question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is tried.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Tried is the past and past participle form of try.

 -Example: She tried to comfort him, but he kept crying.

 
• It's the **simple past** tense.
 
• As the given sentence is in simple past tense, so tried would be a prefect usage. 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to fill in is 'tried'.

​Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• 'trying' **(adjective)**. Used to describe something or someone as trying.
 
• 'try' is a **special verb** in English because we can follow it with either a gerund (ing form) or infinitive.
 
• 'had tried' **(past perfect)** used to emphasize any sentence.
